reply.text: That sounds frightening, and it is one for a doctor, not a coach. Vision going black, even briefly, during a heavy lift needs to be looked at by a doctor before you load anything like that again. Please don't train through it or try to work out the cause on your own. Once you've been cleared, tell me what they say and I'll build the training around it, and I'll keep the leg work honest and lighter until then.
